design.setting: Enclosed garage with a 3.6 m doorway offset 3.0 m from the wall-side target. The target is parallel to the side wall, with a 0.5555 m rear gap and 0.779 m side gap.

provenance.reference: New synthetic offset-doorway garage, using the common TPCAP vehicle
provenance.adaptation: The doorway and wall-side bay have different center lines. Full-body doorway passage and the lateral repositioning inside the garage must both be planned. All five wall rectangles and the exact goal are explicit.

search.reference: Dolgov et al.2010, Dolgov et al. (2010), Sec.2
